senses.zh_definition: 意第绪语女性人名 Tzeitel；也是音乐剧《屋顶上的提琴手》中 Tevye 长女的名字。
senses.en_definition: A Yiddish feminine given name, also borne by Tevye's eldest daughter in Fiddler on the Roof.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan dalam bahasa Yiddish; juga nama anak perempuan sulung Tevye dalam muzikal Fiddler on the Roof.
senses.nuances: 这是专名识别条目，不是已核实的马来语普通词或 DBP 规范词条，故不能标为 official。noun 在此表示专有名词。以下为戏剧讨论中的自然组合，不声称具有马来语高频搭配地位。人名来源依据：[Behind the Name：Tzeitel](https://www.behindthename.com/name/tzeitel)；角色依据：[Music Theatre International：Fiddler on the Roof](https://www.mtishows.com/fiddler-on-the-roof)。本马来语释义为说明性定义，并非官方词典引文。

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 剧场演出介绍
dual_scenarios.ms: Pelakon itu memegang watak Tzeitel, anak perempuan sulung Tevye, dalam pementasan Fiddler on the Roof.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该演员在《屋顶上的提琴手》的舞台演出中饰演 Tevye 的长女 Tzeitel。
dual_scenarios.en: The actor plays Tzeitel, Tevye's eldest daughter, in the production of Fiddler on the Roof.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau dah tengok siapa yang bawa watak Tzeitel malam ni?

dual_scenarios.zh: 你看了今晚是谁演 Tzeitel 吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Have you checked who's playing Tzeitel tonight?

etymology.historical_story: Tzeitel is a Yiddish affectionate form of Sarah. It became familiar to international theatre audiences through Fiddler on the Roof, where Tevye's eldest daughter bears the name. Its appearance in a Malay text therefore need not signal a Malay vocabulary item: a review, programme, or conversation can simply preserve a character's original personal name.
